title: Lazy Sunday Roasted Uruguayan Beef Skillet
description: A hearty, one-pan Uruguayan dish featuring roasted beef, onions, and score-fat, perfect for a lazy Sunday, high in protein and flavor
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
In a large oven-safe skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef for 2-3 minutes per side, then set aside.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and cook until they start to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Return the beef to the skillet, scored side up.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the beef with chimichurri sauce.
Let the beef rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
